logp.method_description: Partition coefficients were measured at 25 °C. Briefly, water (5 mL) saturated with 1-octanol was added to each vial containing weighted amounts of a manganese(II) complex. Then 1 mL of each of these preparative solutions was pipetted into three cuvettes. To each cuvette, 1-octanol (9 mL) saturated with water was added. These solutions were then stoppered and shaken for 3 h, set aside to allow the two phases to separate at 25 °C. Concentrations of manganese(II) complexes in the aqueous phase before (C0) and after partitioning (Cw) were evaluated by spectrophotometry using the pyridyl ring bands (259 nm) of ligands. Based on the concentration ratio of each complex between 1-octanol and water phase, the partition coefficients were calculated as Kow = (C0V0 - CwVw) / CwVw.
